title: What the student can carry
scope: Active book and museum spine; auxiliary sequences indexed as extensions only.

nodes.label: A place to run
nodes.learn: Open, edit, run and stop a supplied scene.
nodes.make: Change a greeting in the prepared room.
nodes.transfer: Change a different property and find the result.
nodes.borrow: Camera, floor, light and editor setup.

nodes.label: A body and a hand
nodes.learn: Use a prepared XR player and controller pickup route.
nodes.make: A scene in which a supplied object can be held.
nodes.transfer: Take another prepared object in the same scene.
nodes.borrow: XR Tools, controller bindings and Quest deployment; portable starter pending.

nodes.label: Begin once, continue
nodes.learn: Initialise, retain a value and update it.
nodes.make: A greeting and a changing count.
nodes.transfer: Change the increment without changing the display machinery.
nodes.borrow: Prepared labels; engine scheduling.

nodes.label: Give a position a body
nodes.learn: Separate a position, its visible surface, collision and illumination.
nodes.make: A point whose appearance and physical boundary can differ.
nodes.transfer: Change the sphere radius while keeping the boundary, or the reverse.
nodes.borrow: Sphere construction; supplied light and switch. Coordinate reading and pickup follow in their own hall.

nodes.label: Hold a point, name its reference
nodes.learn: Use the supplied pickup; read and set X, Y and Z; distinguish local and world positions.
nodes.make: Two independently positioned markers, ready to become endpoints.
nodes.transfer: Move one marker in a translated parent; explain why the world address changes.
nodes.borrow: Production XR pickable, guides and cards. Portable XR starter is still pending.

nodes.label: Connect and measure
nodes.learn: Relate two positions in one reference frame; measure separation.
nodes.make: A segment that follows two movable endpoints.
nodes.transfer: Connect two different objects and preserve its measurement.
nodes.borrow: Line rendering and labels, with inputs explained.

nodes.label: Keep movement
nodes.learn: Introduce an ordered list and a condition for retaining a sample.
nodes.make: A path made from selected positions.
nodes.transfer: Record a different moving point and compare what is lost.
nodes.borrow: Input receiver and line-strip rendering.

nodes.label: Choose an address
nodes.learn: Separate a measured position from a snapped address.
nodes.make: A retained path and a snapped comparison.
nodes.transfer: Change spacing while preserving the original trace.
nodes.borrow: Grid drawing and readouts.

nodes.label: Close edges, give a face
nodes.learn: Close three edges between non-collinear points, then add a face and read its vertex order. Snapping and the carried trace return as further comparisons, not requirements for the first face.
nodes.make: An editable triangular surface with a visible boundary.
nodes.transfer: Move a corner; compare a collapsed triangle with a filled one.
nodes.borrow: Mesh display; the first face needs neither a grid nor the six-corner fan experiment.

nodes.label: Let faces enclose a region
nodes.learn: Join triangular faces into an open corner; add the missing base to close a tetrahedral surface. Separate enclosure from collision and entry.
nodes.make: An open and a closed surface using the same four non-coplanar positions.
nodes.transfer: Remove a different face; compare the visible opening with the supplied convex collision hull.
nodes.borrow: Preview, face renderer and collision comparison. A single triangle was already a mesh.

nodes.label: Keep connections, move a corner
nodes.learn: Keep the triangle indices while changing vertex positions; locate the shared diagonal inside a square-looking cube face.
nodes.make: A cube whose corner can move while its face connections remain.
nodes.transfer: Change a different corner and predict which faces follow; compare with a rigidly folding net.
nodes.borrow: Prepared cube indices and the face renderer already used for the enclosure.

nodes.label: Reuse a made object
nodes.learn: Distinguish a mesh resource, a reusable scene and its placed instances. Arrange familiar parts without rebuilding them.
nodes.make: An arrangement of two instances of a supplied box scene.
nodes.transfer: Move one instance while keeping the other in place; then compare changing a shared resource.
nodes.borrow: Box scene, material and pickup component; explain whether edited resources are shared.

nodes.label: Inspect the prepared form
nodes.learn: Configure a generated mesh; distinguish a fixed polyhedron from a polygonal approximation of a curved surface.
nodes.make: A configurable sphere, capsule or ring.
nodes.transfer: Hold size constant while changing its construction density.
nodes.borrow: Godot primitive classes and renderer.

nodes.label: Choose where to stop
nodes.learn: Follow a subdivision rule and compare a finite approximation with a mathematical limit. A tolerance and the last displayed example have different meanings.
nodes.make: A polygon comparison with a chosen side count and perimeter gap.
nodes.transfer: Choose a positive tolerance; find a member that meets it without claiming exact equality.
nodes.borrow: Circle reference, display and subdivision helper; numerical error analysis can wait.

nodes.label: What geometry promises
nodes.learn: Recognise familiar operations in an authored arrangement.
nodes.make: An arrangement whose geometry can be questioned.
nodes.transfer: Change one relation while preserving a recognisable reference.
nodes.borrow: Historical context and existing sculptures.

nodes.label: Give a form a changing pose
nodes.learn: Translate a familiar object; distinguish assignment, interpolation and carrying.
nodes.make: A moving object with a chosen start and destination.
nodes.transfer: Move another object along the same route with different timing.
nodes.borrow: Pickup base, player transport and safe reset.

nodes.label: Turn around a reference
nodes.learn: Choose a pivot and axis; compare orientation and swept space.
nodes.make: A rotating form with an observable return.
nodes.transfer: Move the pivot while keeping the angular change.
nodes.borrow: Quaternion and collision machinery until required.

nodes.label: Scale meets a body
nodes.learn: Change size relative to a reference and a receiving body.
nodes.make: A size comparison that changes possible passage.
nodes.transfer: Change the receiver instead of repeating the same enlargement.
nodes.borrow: Player scaling infrastructure and safe reset.

nodes.label: A changing boundary
nodes.learn: Combine transforms, proximity and timing; distinguish restoration from memory.
nodes.make: A boundary that changes what can pass.
nodes.transfer: Give the same transform a different trigger or return rule.
nodes.borrow: Detection, door and reset components.

nodes.label: Keep many addresses
nodes.learn: Introduce indexing and loops explicitly; distinguish an address from its occupant.
nodes.make: A row, plane and volume of independently addressable instances.
nodes.transfer: Remove an occupant without moving the other addresses.
nodes.borrow: Instancing helper and flight enclosure.

nodes.label: A local rule covers a surface
nodes.learn: Map a small motif by index; change a rule and one exception separately.
nodes.make: A small tile study and a larger receiving surface.
nodes.transfer: Move the same rule from floor to wall.
nodes.borrow: Tile geometry and display controls.

nodes.label: Give a pattern time
nodes.learn: Separate stored pattern, step index and playback clock.
nodes.make: A monochrome floor with a repeatable temporal pattern.
nodes.transfer: Change timing without changing the stored pattern.
nodes.borrow: Contact input and sound playback.

nodes.label: Add an attribute
nodes.learn: Attach colour to existing construction without changing its geometry.
nodes.make: An arrangement whose parts carry chosen colours.
nodes.transfer: Keep poses fixed while regrouping by colour.
nodes.borrow: Materials and neutral scene lighting.

nodes.label: A colour between things
nodes.learn: Distinguish surface colour, illumination and appearance.
nodes.make: A white receiver under a changeable light.
nodes.transfer: Change the receiver while keeping the light.
nodes.borrow: Renderer, exposure and material setup.

nodes.label: Navigate a colour choice
nodes.learn: Map a gesture or address to channels; distinguish RGB from HSV.
nodes.make: A palette that selects and recalls a colour.
nodes.transfer: Give the same input range a different channel mapping.
nodes.borrow: Hand receiver and prepared palette display.

nodes.label: Leave colour somewhere
nodes.learn: Separate input, surface contact, persistent mark and visual access.
nodes.make: A supplied painting surface that retains a chosen mark.
nodes.transfer: Change the receiving surface and ask what can still be reached.
nodes.borrow: Spray, texture storage and transparency implementation.

nodes.label: Author a source, repeat it
nodes.learn: Separate source motif, palette, index rule and output surface.
nodes.make: A pattern made from an authored motif.
nodes.transfer: Change only the source, then only its repetition rule.
nodes.borrow: Pattern editor and output preview.

nodes.label: Transform the repetition
nodes.learn: Compose translations, reflections and glides; follow an address across a repeat.
nodes.make: A controlled comparison of pattern families.
nodes.transfer: Retain the motif while changing the symmetry rule.
nodes.borrow: Symmetry catalogue, ribbon mesh and viewing controls.

nodes.label: Compare change, accumulate
nodes.learn: Define an independent variable, difference quotient and finite accumulation.
nodes.make: A small slope and accumulated-area study.
nodes.transfer: Change the sampling interval and compare its effect.
nodes.borrow: Plotting and prepared function receiver.

nodes.label: A rule at every position
nodes.learn: Read a vector-valued rule at a position and define how a receiver uses it.
nodes.make: A path following samples of a field.
nodes.transfer: Feed the same field to another receiving rule.
nodes.borrow: Field display and particle drawing.

nodes.label: Combine contributions
nodes.learn: Add and subtract displacements; introduce projection when needed.
nodes.make: An endpoint composed from named contributions.
nodes.transfer: Translate the construction without changing its vector relation.
nodes.borrow: Arrow rendering and coordinate guides.

nodes.label: Let state carry motion
nodes.learn: Separate position, velocity and acceleration; identify the time step.
nodes.make: A moving body whose previous velocity matters.
nodes.transfer: Apply equal commands to bodies with different stored velocities.
nodes.borrow: Physics engine or a clearly identified integration helper.

nodes.label: A law and its receiver
nodes.learn: Relate force, restoring response, drag, mass and support to a particular receiver.
nodes.make: A small force study with a held reference condition.
nodes.transfer: Apply one field to two differently configured bodies.
nodes.borrow: Collision solver, contact and support instruments.

nodes.label: Follow a criterion
nodes.learn: Define a cost, estimate a slope and choose a step.
nodes.make: A descent that can reach different local endings.
nodes.transfer: Keep the cost while changing the start or step size.
nodes.borrow: Landscape display; derivative helper only if explained.

nodes.label: Let relations hold a form
nodes.learn: Introduce anchors, rest lengths and iterative relaxation.
nodes.make: A hanging or relaxed form whose boundary can be edited.
nodes.transfer: Move an anchor instead of specifying the final shape.
nodes.borrow: Solver and stable time step.

nodes.label: Permit another ending
nodes.learn: Compare greedy descent with an explicitly supplied random proposal.
nodes.make: A search whose acceptance rule can be changed.
nodes.transfer: Keep the proposal stream while changing the criterion.
nodes.borrow: Seeded proposals before the full Randomness lesson.

nodes.label: A phase gives a return
nodes.learn: Relate a phase and amplitude to position; compare prescribed motion and dynamics.
nodes.make: A repeated movement and its recorded projection.
nodes.transfer: Change phase independently of amplitude or rate.
nodes.borrow: Trigonometric function and drawing helpers.

nodes.label: Send and combine a wave
nodes.learn: Use position and time in a wave rule; add contributions or modulate a parameter.
nodes.make: A wave field or displaced column.
nodes.transfer: Use the same values for a different receiver.
nodes.borrow: Surface construction and audio buffer when needed.

nodes.label: An event gives sound a beginning
nodes.learn: Separate sampled signal, trigger, envelope and captured silence.
nodes.make: A prepared voice with controllable onset and duration.
nodes.transfer: Trigger the same voice twice and compare independent state.
nodes.borrow: Audio device, buffers and microphone permissions.

nodes.label: Many components, one result
nodes.learn: Sum known components while keeping their amounts and shared phase.
nodes.make: A small additive instrument.
nodes.transfer: Remove one component and locate its consequence.
nodes.borrow: Signal display and audio output.

nodes.label: Keep a procedure, vary a draw
nodes.learn: Introduce seed, sample and eligibility; use a draw in an existing operation.
nodes.make: A repeatable random arrangement or walk.
nodes.transfer: Keep the draws while changing how they are interpreted.
nodes.borrow: Random generator implementation.

nodes.label: A sample has an account
nodes.learn: Distinguish distribution, sample, boundary and record; follow a draw into a consequence.
nodes.make: A sampled population and its histogram or path.
nodes.transfer: Change the admissible set without changing the sampling method.
nodes.borrow: Histogram, trail display and game receiver.

nodes.label: Sample a related field
nodes.learn: Distinguish independent draws from spatially related samples; scale the input domain.
nodes.make: A field mapped to height or colour.
nodes.transfer: Feed the same sample values into another mapping.
nodes.borrow: Noise algorithm implementation and mesh receiver.

nodes.label: A field becomes support
nodes.learn: Separate a scalar value, a threshold, a visible surface and a collider.
nodes.make: A terrain comparison with explicit support.
nodes.transfer: Keep the field while changing height or passage threshold.
nodes.borrow: Terrain meshing and safe walking support.

nodes.label: A rule for a surface sample
nodes.learn: Introduce shader input coordinates and output colour before complex effects.
nodes.make: A small material with a controllable pattern.
nodes.transfer: Apply the same rule to a second mesh.
nodes.borrow: ShaderMaterial setup and rendering pipeline.

nodes.label: Displace, layer, remember
nodes.learn: Distinguish vertex displacement, layered fields and persistent texture state.
nodes.make: A material study whose visible and physical boundaries can differ.
nodes.transfer: Keep geometry fixed while changing the shading rule.
nodes.borrow: Collision remains separate; reaction-diffusion feedback supplied before CA.

nodes.label: A local rule remembers
nodes.learn: Introduce neighbours, discrete state and separate current/next buffers.
nodes.make: A small grid that steps one generation at a time.
nodes.transfer: Change one neighbourhood rule and inspect the global pattern.
nodes.borrow: Display and neighbour-boundary policy made explicit.

nodes.label: Change what a state can be
nodes.learn: Extend binary state to graded values; compare inputs and paired histories.
nodes.make: A local update with a readable difference between two runs.
nodes.transfer: Keep the initial state while changing one coupling.
nodes.borrow: Display; graded-field and multi-state examples.

nodes.label: Replace a part with a rule
nodes.learn: Introduce a terminating recursive step and a depth budget.
nodes.make: A bounded recursively constructed curve or volume.
nodes.transfer: Keep endpoints while replacing what lies between them.
nodes.borrow: Mesh batching and safe geometry budget.

nodes.label: Rewrite, then interpret
nodes.learn: Separate a symbol sequence from its geometric reading; introduce a state stack.
nodes.make: A rewritten sentence read by a moving point.
nodes.transfer: Read the same sentence with another angle or interpretation.
nodes.borrow: Turtle drawing and stack preview.

nodes.label: A rule becomes a place
nodes.learn: Carry a grammar into width, support, competition and face operations.
nodes.make: An architectural or form-grammar variant.
nodes.transfer: Preserve the rule while changing which faces or resources qualify.
nodes.borrow: Generation budgets and full-scale support.

nodes.label: Build, score, choose
nodes.learn: Separate a genome, its constructed body and the criterion that selects it.
nodes.make: A small population with inspectable selection.
nodes.transfer: Use another score on the same candidates.
nodes.borrow: Population display and mutation source.

nodes.label: A connection needs room
nodes.learn: Choose a local growth/connection rule; distinguish connectivity from bodily clearance.
nodes.make: A growing network and a carved route.
nodes.transfer: Change eligibility or width while keeping the initial points.
nodes.borrow: Neighbour search and carving/meshing; graph vocabulary returns later.

nodes.label: Keep a body in relation
nodes.learn: Vary pins, pressure and constitutive settings independently of presentation.
nodes.make: A supplied deformable body with an authored boundary condition.
nodes.transfer: Change an attachment rather than its visible form.
nodes.borrow: Soft-body solver, stable mesh and collision setup.

nodes.label: Two fields change each other
nodes.learn: Separate local reaction, diffusion, update step and display.
nodes.make: A small two-field update with controllable coupling.
nodes.transfer: Hold the start and change one response term.
nodes.borrow: Field storage and surface extraction where used.

nodes.label: Extract a boundary
nodes.learn: Sample a scalar field; choose a level; interpolate crossings before assembling faces.
nodes.make: A small sampled volume with an inspectable surface.
nodes.transfer: Change threshold without changing the source field.
nodes.borrow: Marching-cubes case table and mesh plumbing.

nodes.label: Compose the condition
nodes.learn: Edit contributions and domains; distinguish a height map from a volume.
nodes.make: A cavity, terrain or joined field surface.
nodes.transfer: Keep the extractor and replace the field.
nodes.borrow: Meshing, collision and rebuild scheduling.

nodes.label: Make room by subtraction
nodes.learn: Define union, intersection and ordered difference of solids.
nodes.make: A cavity or room whose operands can be repositioned.
nodes.transfer: Swap operand order, then scale the resulting negative space.
nodes.borrow: CSG engine; does not require implementing marching cubes.

nodes.label: A local view of others
nodes.learn: Give an agent state, a sensing neighbourhood and an update policy.
nodes.make: A small group responding to neighbours or a shared trail.
nodes.transfer: Change perception while keeping the response rule.
nodes.borrow: Neighbour lookup and trail diffusion.

nodes.label: Remember and compare routes
nodes.learn: Separate personal memory, shared signal and optimisation criterion.
nodes.make: A route or position search with inspectable memory.
nodes.transfer: Keep the candidates while changing who can share a result.
nodes.borrow: Graph storage before its formal chapter.

nodes.label: Choose what improvement means
nodes.learn: Define data, features, labels and an objective; distinguish clustering from classification.
nodes.make: A small classifier or optimiser with a visible criterion.
nodes.transfer: Change labels or the cost while preserving the observations.
nodes.borrow: Dataset display and training helpers.

nodes.label: Compose a learned mapping
nodes.learn: Use a supplied layer, then inspect one weighted sum, bias and activation.
nodes.make: A small mapping with editable weights.
nodes.transfer: Compare a single unit with a layered response.
nodes.borrow: Network first as a supplied component; single-unit inspection follows.

nodes.label: A mapping retains or generates
nodes.learn: Distinguish hidden state, generated sample and learned parameters.
nodes.make: A prepared model whose state or input can be changed separately.
nodes.transfer: Reset state without replacing weights.
nodes.borrow: Trained models and training machinery; not a one-chapter GAN implementation.

nodes.label: Name the relations
nodes.learn: Separate node identity, edge relation and drawing position.
nodes.make: An explicit graph with an independent layout.
nodes.transfer: Move the drawing without changing the adjacency.
nodes.borrow: Layout solver; returns to earlier networks.

nodes.label: Choose a route or allocation
nodes.learn: Introduce queues/stacks when used; compare reachability, cost, capacity and matching.
nodes.make: A small path or allocation experiment.
nodes.transfer: Keep the graph and change the question asked of it.
nodes.borrow: Algorithm implementations beyond the first taught traversal.

nodes.label: A model has conditions
nodes.learn: Identify a geometric assumption and a changed interpretation.
nodes.make: A controlled comparison of models.
nodes.transfer: Hold an observation while changing the model's premise.
nodes.borrow: Geometry renderers; no theorem proved by the display.

nodes.label: A claim and its warrant
nodes.learn: Distinguish construction, consistency, proof, projection and toy demonstration.
nodes.make: A small explicit rule system with declared limits.
nodes.transfer: Find a claim the demonstration cannot establish.
nodes.borrow: Formal results require their own arguments; no forced coding quota.

nodes.label: Read what a measure measures
nodes.learn: Give each project term a stated operational measure and scope.
nodes.make: A comparison of order, variation and response under declared rules.
nodes.transfer: Replace one proxy while keeping the physical arrangement.
nodes.borrow: QFEP as the project's research framing; entropy and spread are not interchangeable.

nodes.label: Connect an intervention
nodes.learn: Distinguish a control value, a connection and the receiver's used value.
nodes.make: An intervention that can be connected, cut and compared.
nodes.transfer: Cut a route without assuming its previous effect is undone.
nodes.borrow: Receiver models and UI; verify each coupling.

nodes.label: Keep the source with the judgement
nodes.learn: Retain provenance, competing requirements and contributors rather than only a verdict.
nodes.make: An arrangement that exposes who or what its rule admits.
nodes.transfer: Change a rule while keeping the excluded case visible.
nodes.borrow: Authored scenarios and provenance display.

nodes.label: Make a work answer back
nodes.learn: Combine routes, assemblies and records into a situated work.
nodes.make: A first independent work built from selected earlier capabilities.
nodes.transfer: Name one promise, test it bodily, and revise the responsible operation.
nodes.borrow: Only the infrastructure the chosen work needs.

sequence_questions.primitives: What must we add before a position can be seen, connected, kept, enclosed and used again; what does each addition allow or leave out?
sequence_questions.transformation: What remains the same, and whose passage changes when the form moves?
sequence_questions.array_tutorial: Does removing an occupant erase its address or change what a body can stand on?
sequence_questions.color: Which part of a colour belongs to a surface, a light, a receiver or a social permission?
sequence_questions.tiling: How does one local choice become the order surrounding us?
sequence_questions.change: Which interval makes a change visible, and what does accumulation retain?
sequence_questions.forces: A force acts on which body, with which memory and resistance?
sequence_questions.formfinding: Who chose the criterion under which this form appears to have found its place?
sequence_questions.wavefunctions: Is the return prescribed, physically produced, recorded or only apparently the same?
sequence_questions.randomness: Who chooses the set within which chance is allowed to operate?
sequence_questions.noise: What changes when a field value becomes colour, height or support?
sequence_questions.shaders: What can an appearance promise that the body of the room does not provide?
sequence_questions.cellularautomata: What global consequence follows from this local neighbourhood and update?
sequence_questions.fractals: Which finite budget gives this apparent infinity its body?
sequence_questions.lsystems: What does a rule say, and what does its interpreter allow it to become?
sequence_questions.proceduralgeneration: What counts as a desirable body or a connected, usable route?
sequence_questions.softbodies: What holds a deforming body together, and which attachments are allowed to change?
sequence_questions.isosurfaces: Which samples and threshold are enough to declare a boundary?
sequence_questions.boolean_surfaces: When does taking something away make room for another body?
sequence_questions.swarmintelligence: Whose local information contributes to the apparent collective decision?
sequence_questions.machinelearning: What has been named a feature, a label or an improvement?
sequence_questions.graphtheory: Which relation survives when the picture is rearranged?
sequence_questions.foundationscrisis: What does this model let us claim, and what cannot follow from this demonstration?
sequence_questions.qfeplaboratory: What exactly does the instrument measure, and where does the interpretation exceed it?
sequence_questions.postfoundationscrisis: Can the work keep its conditions, exclusions and possible revisions available to others?

issues.title: Deliver the held point
issues.finding: Point Coordinates follows the corridor, but its download has no player or pickup rig.
issues.action: Supply and test a reduced XR starter; teach object-side pickup, then reuse the same point in Line.

issues.title: One connection before 64 points
issues.finding: The Line tutorial opens with an 8-by-8 grid, nested arrays and helper calls before the first connection.
issues.action: Make one measurable segment from the two Point Coordinates endpoints. Introduce loops with a later need.

issues.title: Introduce the record before its machinery
issues.finding: Trace opens with a source excerpt containing recording gates, shaping and list operations.
issues.action: Teach a tiny ordered list and one retention condition first. Reuse Line distance; borrow rendering.

issues.title: Triangle edges are a step inside the active hall
issues.finding: Point_Triangle is not in the active primitives map list. The current Point_Triangle_Context tutorial already moves from edges to face.
issues.action: Keep both conceptual steps in Point_Triangle_Context. Do not add or reorder maps merely to draw this tree.

issues.title: A random proposal arrives before Randomness
issues.finding: Annealing uses random proposals before the dedicated Randomness sequence.
issues.action: Supply a named repeatable proposal stream here; return to its seed and distribution later.

issues.title: Feedback arrives before its full local-rule lesson
issues.finding: The Shader sequence contains a reaction-diffusion encounter before CA and the later Soft Bodies return.
issues.action: Use a supplied feedback texture now; teach the two-field update later. Distinguish a return from a repeated lesson.

issues.title: Whole network, then one unit
issues.finding: Neural Networks precedes Perception deliberately; the latter is a zoom into a single unit.
issues.action: Name the supplied network interface first. Teach its unit when the route zooms in; do not automatically reorder.

issues.title: Networks before Graph Theory
issues.finding: Growth and swarm examples already need adjacency and paths before the formal Graph Theory sequence.
issues.action: Introduce the smallest useful connection record where first needed; Graph Theory later generalises it.

issues.title: Tutorial and current technical account disagree
issues.finding: The tutorial describes position spread, while the current technical account counts equal-weight branch endings and reports ln(N).
issues.action: Reconcile the learner lesson against the current encounter. Never silently call spread Shannon entropy or treat a project proxy as universal.

issues.title: Follow the encounter, not the old map name
issues.finding: The current CA_GameOfLife tutorial follows retained rows and histories; the explicit Life dish occurs in CA_BeyondBinary.
issues.action: Use the source encounter titles in the atlas; verify the intended teaching step before changing names or order.
